d: Die Food-Journalistin Carlay Hayes findet ihr Glück, als sie ihre eigene TV-Show. Sie wird in eine Kleinstadt geschickt, wo sie eine Sendung über den Koch Grant Quinn machen muss, der das alte Restaurant ihrer Familie wiedereröffnen will.

Hanson and Penhall must infiltrate a prison undercover as inmates to conduct an investigation. Unfortunately, they run into trouble due to the corrupt and violent guard, which becomes too much for Penhall. Thus, Hanson continues the investigation alone and discovers that drugs are being smuggled inside the prison.

After his girlfriend breaks up with him, Penhall moves in with Ioki, who can't handle Penhall's messiness. Hoffs faces bigger problems: She ends things with her boyfriend Marcus Rainey because he has hidden from her that he is married.

Penhall investigates at a high school and encounters a student who reminds him of Jack Archer. Archer made his life difficult back in elementary school. When he shares this incident with his Jump Street colleagues, everyone has their own story to tell about it.

Hanson is temporarily suspended from duty because his friend Russell Buckins published an article that portrays the Jump Street program poorly. To restore his reputation, Hanson must find Russell so he can speak for him before the inquiry committee.

Soldier Weaver is pressured so hard by his training officer Wilcox that he deserts. Wilcox asks Captain Fuller to bring Weaver back before he is officially considered a deserter and faces worse trouble.
